paragraphs: Chapter 450
Episode 128: Zephyrin (6)
"And have a healer and a poison expert examine him immediately."
The Black Knight no longer trembled. He looked like he was about to die, just weakly exhaling breaths.
The members moved the Black Knight to a stretcher.
"We must keep him alive. If he dies, it won't be good for the Black King's Order or me. Especially for the Black King's Order, there is a high possibility that it won't just end with inconvenience."
"Don't worry, Jin!"
As the 3rd Captain Muraka responded, healing-specialized mercenaries and doctors from the Black King's Order gathered around the stretcher.
"On the contrary, if we can save him, it will be a great advantage for both me and the Black King's Order."
If the Black Knight were to die on the Black King's Order's land, regardless of the reason, it would inevitably give Joshua the justification to pressure Valkas.

However, if the situation were reversed, it would be Valkas, not Joshua, who could request compensation. Jin would also not have to lose the strongest armor of his family, and perhaps he could even try to negotiate directly with the Black Knight.
"We've saved him in worse situations more than once."
"We will definitely keep him alive!"
Crack, thud!
As the medical team rushed to perform emergency treatment, suddenly a loud noise and a tremor shook the entire Black King's stronghold.

It was like a volcanic eruption, with aura, magic, spirit, and thunder energy bursting from between the narrowing gaps in the space. The energy of the battlefield intensified even more since Jin had come out.
'It's a monster. The space is collapsing, and it seemed to be cornered, but it still reveals such power.'
Murakan said there was no need to come back, but Jin was still worried. They needed to evacuate the Black King's Order as quickly as possible and then rejoin the battle.
"…What kind of battle is going on in there? Zephyrin, are you really saying that damned thing is that monster!"
The 2nd Captain spoke with a voice full of frustration.
Seeing Zephyrin, transformed into a human, fighting with the party and Jin was unbelievable even to their own eyes.
Zephyrin.
Recently, she had been the troublemaker of the Black King's Order, making life difficult for all her seniors and supervisors.
However, at the same time, she was also the youngest member who, despite being scolded and reprimanded every day, spread her unique lively and cheerful energy, making her impossible to hate.
Now, Zephyrin had transformed into a monster that plunged the Black King's stronghold into an unprecedented crisis. The sight of the giant snake's form appearing and disappearing was nauseating.
"Did any of the subordinates, including the 2nd Captain, fall victim to that creature? Are there any Black King's Order members who have been affected by Zephyrin?"
"Absolutely none, 12th generation."
"Thank goodness."
The problem that Valkas was most worried about had not occurred yet.
'If we manage to evacuate everyone without any harm afterward, we can expect a positive flow of conversation with Valkas later.'
Kyaaaaak-!
Zephyrin's roar could be heard from beyond the space's gap. Although it sounded distant, it was a powerful roar that even members who hadn't experienced it firsthand could imagine its strength.
The escape was gaining speed.
Although they said that this had never happened before, it was the same for all fortresses. Heukwang Fortress also had more than one or two special passages, devices, and guidelines for escape.
Ladders were spread out throughout the fortress, and magical devices for lowering supplies were activated.
Apart from the urgent and gloomy situation, it was quite a spectacle. The huge castles lined up in the mountain range moved like a single organism with flawless coordination.
Jin looked at the Black King Corps escaping as he left the central castle where the Black King Commander's reception room was located.
Hundreds of special ropes connected the castles, allowing people and supplies to move back and forth, and the castles moved without a break like intricate machines.

It was unknown what kind of devices were set up in the rugged mountains surrounding the castle, but whenever a small explosion was heard somewhere, a landslide occurred near the castle, creating a slippery path.
Supplies and non-combat personnel used that path to descend the mountain range, and in the meantime, barriers were spread out in various places in the castles and walls.

The barriers were not deployed by the corps members but by the magical equipment set up by the Black King Corps. There were so many such barriers that it was difficult to count them with the naked eye.
'Just looking at this much, I can't even imagine how much money was invested.'
Not only money but also having such close connections with the magic tool makers of the empire and the Lutero Magic Federation would have been necessary to acquire such equipment.

This was possible because the Black King Corps was a neutral force and a mercenary group. Providing such supplies to Runcandel was tantamount to treason for the magic tool makers. Most of the war magic tools that Runcandel could obtain were spoils of battle victories.
The escape was going very smoothly.
True to the world's best mercenary group, the Black King Corps showed a calm response even in an emergency they had never experienced before.
The mountain range where the fortress was located had almost entirely collapsed.

Most of the corps members had already completed their evacuation, and Jin, the commander, and the officers were hanging on ropes on the path created by the landslide, looking at the battlefield of the central castle.
To be precise, they were watching the central castle collapse.
"Whew."
"Commander…!"
The energy breaking through the aetheric space turned the central castle to dust.
The blue flames attached to the crack were much more frequent than before, but the energy continuously tearing the crack seemed to be very effective.
'Soon, the aetheric space will be completely torn apart.'
What would happen next?
Although it was impossible for Zephyrin to transform back to her original form, the fight would continue. Even in her human form, Zephyrin had at least the power of a 10-star rank.
However, that fight wouldn't last long. Zephyrin was in a worn-out state after taking multiple hits, and Jin's party and Valkas were in the same situation, so the only thing left was a short fight.
'We can't kill Zephyrin here. We've saved the members from great danger for now, so the best outcome would be to retreat without inflicting fatal injuries on each other.'
It was uncertain what other tricks Zephyrin might have left, even if she was exhausted. Judging by the shocking power she had shown, the situation could change at any moment.
Most importantly.
If the fight spread 'outside the aetheric space', people would undoubtedly come from external forces.
The Black King Corps was a neutral force that the whole world had its eyes on. If a fight of a certain scale broke out in the Heuk
If a fight of a certain size took place at Heukwang Mountain Fortress, it was impossible for the nearby forces not to notice it.
'From the beginning, creating a separate space in the reception room without killing the two leaders and their subordinates must have been for the purpose of quietly handling their objectives.'
The unprotected area in the center of the continent where Heukwang Mountain Fortress was located, the Bise Kingdom.
The Bise Kingdom didn't belong to any of the four powers, but geographically, it was quite close to the territories of Zipple and Vermont.
And recently, the atmosphere between them and Kinzelo was not very friendly.
'If they took into account that they would come, Zephrin would definitely choose to run away.'
At that moment.
Screech!
Finally, the sound of the separate space tearing apart was heard. Jin and the members of Heukwang Unit swallowed their saliva and looked up at the collapsed central castle.
The view of the battlefield seen through the cracks was too chaotic to accurately understand the internal situation.
Roar...!
The first to appear outside the crack was Murakan.
He roared and showed off his majesty, and then breathed toward Zephrin, who had escaped after him.
At that sight, Jin felt a surge of relief in his heart.
'He's safe!'
However, seeing Valkas and Shaku, who had escaped afterward, and especially Shaku's appearance, he also felt heartbroken.
Shaku looked like he was struggling to stand, having suffered fatal injuries all over his body.
Although Jin hadn't seen the battle directly, he immediately recognized that Shaku's condition was a sign of sacrifice.
As a guardian made of souls and spirit energy, Shaku's death and injuries were not real. Therefore, it was natural for Shaku to sacrifice himself without hesitation for Jin and his comrades.
Even if it wasn't a body made of spirit energy, but a real physical body, it would have been the same. That was the brotherly love of the Myeongwang tribe.
"Shaku, my brother!"
He didn't explicitly say sorry or thank you. Shaku, who responded to Jin's voice, turned his head and grinned when their eyes met.
"Be sure to tell me later how I did today, Jin, my brother."
Shaku's body disintegrated into spirit energy, and Jin clenched his teeth and gathered his energy. It was time to end the fight.
"Captain and officers, continue to protect the members!"
It was much more efficient than fighting together.
There was no guarantee that joining the captains could kill Zephrin, while the chances of ordinary members not being harmed by her attacks were too low.
With a whoosh!
Spirit energy and blue fire rekindled in Bradamante. Jin wanted to unleash the magic sword technique right away, but he couldn't risk harming his comrades.
Clang-!
Jin's leaping sword fell on Zephrin's forehead.
Zephrin easily blocked the sword with her fingernails, but she seemed quite uncomfortable with the blue fire unfolding in front of her nose.
And her energy had noticeably weakened. Of course, it was only weak compared to her true form; she still possessed tremendous power.
Screech, crack!
Bradamante and the fingernails clashed, causing an explosion. Murakan alternated between his true form and human form to assist Jin, while Valkas was catching his breath.
Valkas had also sustained significant injuries, not as much as Shaku, and was poisoned by Zephrin's toxins.
"Jin Runcandel, you...!"
Zephyrin spoke as she struggled against Jin's power.
"Why don't you act as confident as you were before? You were talking as if you could kill us at any time, weren't you?"
At that, Zephyrin narrowed her eyes.
However, she soon regained her smiling face and said this.
"Soon, we'll meet again, Jin Runcandel."
"Yeah, you guys always say that before running away..."
Just as Jin was about to continue speaking, Zephyrin's body suddenly began to inflate, turning purple as if it would burst at any moment.
Jin was not the only one who felt the intuition.
[Watch out, kid!]
Before Murakan could shout that, Jin had already distanced himself and was heading toward Valkas.
"Well, goodbye!"
Kwaaaa...!
Zephyrin's body, swollen with magic, exploded.
A powerful earthquake shook the entire mountain range, and the trees and rocks around the epicenter of the explosion disappeared without a trace.
It was a huge explosion that seemed to threaten to collapse the entire Heukwang Mountain Range, but its actual power was not truly overwhelming.
From the beginning, Zephyrin had no intention of killing Jin; she only caused the explosion to escape.
It was fortunate that the Heukwang Mountain Range was equipped with various defensive magic devices, and that Jin, Murakan, the captain, and executive-level members still had some energy left.
"Block it!"
"The 12th group has taken care of the commander! Groups 1, 2, and 3, protect each other!"
The mountain range was breaking apart due to the magic explosion.
If most of the members had not evacuated beforehand, it would have been a disaster. Jin, Murakan, and the Heukwang members desperately fought off the explosion and its aftermath.
In particular, Murakan squeezed out the remaining spirit power to form barriers throughout the mountain range, saving many people.
[Urajeel, causing trouble until the very end!]
The explosion, followed by landslides and earthquakes, finally stopped almost an hour later.
In the end, the group managed to prevent major casualties from the explosion.
However, the once-majestic Heukwang Mountain Range was now completely destroyed, buried in debris, with moans and cries of the Heukwang members echoing beneath the collapsed mountains.
Murakan, still floating in the night sky soaked with spirit power, looked down at the Heukwang members with a somewhat pitiful expression.
Those who knew the whole situation would understand that his appearance was due to sympathy.
However, the newly arrived personnel and dragons from Zipple and Vermont, who had rushed to the scene after detecting the battle, did not.
"What, what's going on...!? The Heukwang Mountain Range!"
[Murakan!? Could it be, Murakan?]
[Murakan brother...!? Brother did this?]
[Myu, mu, Murakan...?]
"If that's the case, could it be that Runcandel's 12th group...destroyed the Heukwang Group...!"
The people from Zipple and Vermont who had arrived at the scene of destruction and saw Murakan could not help but fall into a huge misunderstanding.
